content.comment_body: Could someone advise how to use a two-wire proximity switch as a 220V input?

Hello, Have you checked section 2.3 in the current [product_name] manual? It explains how to connect the sensor. Make sure your sensor meets the specifications for detecting a 0 signal, meaning its current in the 0 state must be below the threshold required for signal status 0. You can find the manual at [url]. Hope this helps.
